simple_content.title: Return & Refund Policy
simple_content.content:
This policy outlines the return and refund procedures for services provided by TSV Global Solutions Pvt Ltd.

1. Service Cancellations

Cancellation requests must be submitted in writing. Cancellation charges may apply depending on the stage of service delivery.

2. Refund Eligibility

Refunds are considered on a case-by-case basis for services not yet rendered. Services already in progress may not be eligible for full refund.

3. Processing Time

Approved refunds will be processed within 7-14 business days to the original payment method.

4. Non-Refundable Items

Government fees, customs duties, port charges, and third-party service charges are non-refundable once incurred.

5. Disputes

For disputes or refund requests, please contact our customer service at cs@tsvglobal.com with your service reference number.
